name: CodeViewer
description: Shows code of any size, with the same scrolling and highlighting, and no editing.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the editor for assistive technology.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: describedBy
props.description: The id of an element describing the editor.

props.name: document
props.description: A document of any size, from `openFile` or `connectDocument`. Takes priority over `value`.

props.name: onStatus
props.description: Reports the caret, the size tier and the line numbers' exactness.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: screenReader
props.description: Mirror the current line into the input, for screen readers.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled text, for short content. A large file belongs in a `document`.
